about.Intro: 周见 is a personal web periodical about the interesting things I come across on the internet.
about.Name: The name 周见 (Zhōu Jiàn) joins 周, "week", with 见, "to see": what the week brought into view. The hope behind it is to notice something good in study and in life each week, and to pass on the novel things I find.
about.SectionsIntro: Every issue has the same departments:
about.SectionCover: Cover — a photograph taken or found that week.
about.SectionInteresting: Interesting — things worth a second look.
about.SectionLinks: Link Sharing — links worth your time.
about.SectionQuotes: Quotes — a line or two that stayed with me.
about.SectionBGM: Each issue also comes with a BGM track.
